systems.country_label: Education Management Information System (EMIS); school census data (SIGE)
systems.owner: Ministry of National Education and Civic Promotion (DPACS); extension financed under the PRET
systems.tiers: Collects data from schools since 2009, analysed centrally into an annual statistical yearbook; decentralised to 16 provinces with seven more to follow under the PRET; feedback to principals and local inspectors does not always arrive; 12,863 primary schools as of 2025

note: The EMIS is described only as collecting data from schools for a centrally analysed annual yearbook, and the figure calls it school census data; no per-learner record and no entry by schools during the year is stated, so it is a census and gives no fact.
